title: Skill discovery review procedure
goal: Each project can run a periodic review that finds and refreshes its own skills
acceptance: core/docs/agents/skills.md has a skill discovery review: sources, the four outcomes and the report at docs/reviews/skills/<date>.md
The opt-in reviews.skills.days is documented and check:freshness warns on a missing or stale report (a test covers it if the reviews check has none for a new name)
The harness enables reviews.skills for itself
privacy: Procedure and config text only; examples invented; no personal data.
escalation: A discovery rule that would make the harness own a project's skills goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23: one procedure section and an opt-in through the existing reviews.<name>.days check.
